instruction: Forecasts must explicitly distinguish observed tenant data, trend extrapolation, hypothetical scenario, and independently verified forecast. Link to goals, actions and evidenced runtime. Never treat global platform forecasts as tenant data, or portray an unmeasured effect as realized value. Sensitivity choices describe favourable or adverse scenarios relative to the goal direction. Positive sensitivity must reduce a down-goal such as risk/manual workload and increase an up-goal, including improvement from a negative baseline.
authority: tenant-authenticated portal state; no global registry assumption
